prBodyNotes: **Do not merge this without re-verifying `src/client/slidingSync.ts` against the target version.** This repo deep-imports the INTERNAL path `matrix-js-sdk/lib/sliding-sync`, which is unsupported surface: the `SlidingSync` class is not exported from the public entry, and a future version can move, rename or retype it without notice. A green typecheck is not sufficient evidence, because the import can resolve while the runtime shape has changed. Check whether `SlidingSync` is public yet, and whether the class signature, list-config shape or endpoint moved. See CLIENT_MANIFEST.md and the standing rule at the top of that file.

Also re-read `docs/plan/E2EE_DM_PLAN.md`: the crypto surface used by the e2ee-dms campaign (`initRustCrypto`, `CryptoApi`, `DecryptionFailureCode`) is checked against the installed SDK by `checks/decryptionState.check.ts` and `checks/cryptoProgress.check.ts`, so a bump that changes those will fail the gate rather than land quietly. That is intended: treat a failure there as the check doing its job.
